> 繕性於俗，俗學以求復其初；滑欲於俗，思以求致其明；謂之蔽蒙之民。

Repair your nature within custom, use customary learning to get back to the beginning; muddle your desires within custom, and use thought to reach clarity — such people are called the benighted.

The chapter's title is 繕性, and its first sentence is an attack on 繕性. That is not a mistake. The title is the thing being taken apart.

## 繕 means to patch

繕: to mend, to patch, to repair something worn.

A patched thing is not an original thing. The word presupposes damage and presupposes that the repair is done from outside, with material at hand. So the title already contains the objection the first line makes: you cannot patch your way back to 初.

## 滑 reads 汩: to muddle

滑欲於俗 — 滑 here is read 汩: to stir up, to disorder.

Muddle the desires in the middle of custom, and then use thinking to try to arrive at clarity. 莊子's verdict is that both halves of that sentence are the same mistake: the setting is the problem, and effort inside the setting cannot fix it.

## 恬 and 知 raise each other

恬: quiet. 知: awareness, 智.

The chapter's method is the mutual nurture of these two: 恬養知，知養恬 — quiet feeds awareness, awareness feeds quiet. Neither can be pushed directly. Push quiet and you get numbness; push awareness and you get agitation. Each is the other's condition.

This is the most practically useful sentence in the chapter, and it is a sentence about pacing, not about virtue.

## 澆淳散樸: four verbs, one generation dismantled

澆: to thin, to make shallow. 淳: thick, honest. 散: to scatter. 樸: unhewn wood.

Four actions in four characters: the thick is thinned, the plain is scattered. Read as social history, it is a description of how a generation's material gets degraded — not by malice, by processing.

## 險德以行

險: dangerous, steep. 德 made into something 險 — high, hard to walk.

Note that 險 here is not "sinister." It is terrain. Virtue turned into a difficult path, which people then admire and cannot walk.

## 反一無迹

反 reads 返: to return. 一: the undifferentiated. 無迹: no footprint left.

Return to the one, and leave no tracks. The second clause is the harder one — a return that advertises itself has already left a print, and a print is a new thing to be followed.

## 儻來: what arrives by chance

儻: by accident, as it happens.

富貴名位 are 儻來之物 — things that happen to arrive. Not rewards, not results; arrivals. The word strips them of causality, and with it of the claim they make on you.

## 倒置

倒置: inverted, the top put at the bottom.

The inversion named here: treating the deposited external as the root, and one's own nature as secondary. Not a moral failure. A structural one — the load-bearing part has been moved.

## The test

Name one thing you are currently repairing in yourself, and the standard you are repairing it to. Then ask the 繕 question: is that standard the 初 — the original — or is it a shape that custom issued and you accepted as original? If it is the second, the repair will succeed and you will be further from the beginning than before.
